title: Discrete quotient comparison for reconstructed small section rings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative ring, and $I$ an ideal of $A$. Write $J$ for the coefficient-sized small pro-etale model topology and $B=\operatorname{ULift}(A)$ for the coefficient universe lift. Let $K$ be the image of $I$ under the inverse universe-lift ring equivalence. The discrete condensed ring, inverse image, reconstructed section ring, and small-site maps are those of [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data]. There exist ring-sheaf isomorphisms from the constant sheaf $B$ to the reconstructed small ring of the pulled-back discrete $A$, and from the constant quotient sheaf $B/K$ to the reconstructed small ring of the pulled-back discrete $A/I$, such that the square formed by these isomorphisms and the actual quotient maps commutes. Constants and their quotient map are those of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. This asserts a comparison of coefficient presentations only; no kernel formula or generating sections are asserted.

proof.text: Use the monoidal constant-sheaf comparison for scheme inverse image on the additive group of ULift A. The constant-commute-compose comparison identifies the underlying abelian ring of the discrete ring sheaf with that constant abelian ring. Their composite is an isomorphism of internal commutative rings.

Reconstruct section rings and precompose along the AsSmall site equivalence. Both operations preserve isomorphisms. Constant sheaves commute with this site equivalence by the terminal-sections adjunction. This gives the first isomorphism and the corresponding one for A/I.

The ring equivalence ULift A to A induces a quotient equivalence from (ULift A)/K to A/I, whose inverse universe lift gives ULift(A/I). Compose its constant-sheaf image with the second comparison. Naturality of all comparison maps in the quotient homomorphism gives the displayed square.

lean.statement:
theorem discrete_quotient_comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) :
    let J := Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X
    let B := ULift.{u + 1} A
    let K : Ideal B := Ideal.map
      (ULift.ringEquiv : B ≃+* A).symm.toRingHom I
    let R := condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X
    let S := condensedRingObj (discreteObj (A ⧸ I)) X
    ∃ e : ConstantCompletion.constant J B ≅ smallRing X R,
      ∃ f : ConstantCompletion.finite J B K 0 ≅ smallRing X S,
        ConstantCompletion.quotient J B K 0 ≫ f.hom =
          e.hom ≫ smallMap X (R := R) (S := S)
            ((upperStarFromPoint X).map (discreteMap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
